profile.summary: Elementary teacher with seven years in second and third grade and an Oregon Professional Teaching License with Elementary–Multiple Subjects and ESOL endorsements. Known for small-group reading work and steady communication with families.

descriptions: Teach 26 students, nine of them English learners; the share reading at grade level rose from 58% to 77% in one year
Run daily small-group reading blocks using running records to regroup students every three weeks
Send a short weekly update to families in English and Spanish and hold conferences twice a year with 100% attendance
Mentor two student teachers from Filbert Hill University each spring
Moved the class to Google Classroom in two weeks during remote learning and kept daily attendance above 90%
Built a math station rotation that the grade-level team used across all four second grade classes
Served on the school's behavior support team and helped write the first schoolwide reward system
Coached the after-school running club for 40 students in grades 2 to 5
